name: QlickCRM Integration for Contact Form 7
author: QlickCRM

sections.description:
QlickCRM Integration for Contact Form 7 allows you to automatically send Contact Form 7 form submissions to your QlickCRM system.

After connecting your QlickCRM API credentials, you can:

  • Map any Contact Form 7 form to a QlickCRM module or partner record type
  • Define field mappings between CF7 form fields and QlickCRM fields
  • Automatically create or update CRM records on every form submission
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Contact Form 7.
  2. Upload and activate this plugin.
  3. Go to QlickCRM CF7 in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your QlickCRM URL and API key to connect your account.
  5. Add a new form integration and configure the field mappings.
